articles.title: Carmakers gear up with multi-powertrain models as Indian buyers shift beyond petrol, diesel
articles.titleEn: Carmakers gear up with multi-powertrain models as Indian buyers shift beyond petrol, diesel
articles.summary: Car manufacturers are expanding powertrain offerings by introducing electric, CNG, hybrid, and petrol options. Companies like Renault and Stellantis are addressing regional demands for efficient engines and diverse vehicles. The rising fuel prices and tighter emission norms are compelling automakers to adapt their strategies. Toyota and Mahindra are focusing on multi-energy platforms to meet market needs effectively.
